request_summary: Run the GEC integration suite, inspect errors, and propose a QA fix plan while preserving the approved branch baseline.

actions.description: Read the QA-orchestrator persona, session-routing and operations workflows, runner workflow, run instructions, ACE schema, and trace guide.
Verified the current branch and worktree, resolved GEC DEV configuration and external test effects, and obtained explicit user approval for the exact run plan.
Delegated one full-suite execution to QA-runner; independently checked the seven JUnit files, 52 cases, failure distribution, Allure artifacts, and unchanged baseline.
Assigned report-only closure to QA-closer after QA-runner could not persist the required report; verified the UTF-8 report update and no unexpected worktree changes.

outcome.detail: The approved run, error review, and report-only persistence completed with verified artifacts. The suite remains failed with seven unresolved scenarios; no fix, rerun, remote observation, or publication was performed.

friction.description: QA-runner lacked an edit tool for the existing failure report; a bounded report-only QA-closer task completed the update.

An attempted --help invocation of prepare_delegation.js was unsupported and returned an undefined-agent error; the CLI was read and the actual participants' manifests were then prepared with explicit arguments.
